business_summary: Fujian Tendering Co., Ltd. provides engineering supervision, test and inspection, surveying and mapping, geographic information, survey and design, and other engineering consulting services in China. The company offers technical consulting and management services; and process consulting, project construction management, project management, engineering supervision, project feasibility studies, and cost consulting services for building construction, municipal public works, mechanical and electrical installation, power, and communication projects. It also provides quality supervision, construction safety supervision, construction environmental protection supervision, cost supervision, progress supervision, contract management, information and document management, and other matters; testing and inspection services; tendering agency services and pre-project consulting services; surveying and geographic information services; and surveying and design comprising engineering surveying and engineering design services. In addition, the company offers cost consulting, maintenance and reinforcement, and price certification consulting; maintenance, repair, and reinforcement services for transportation, building, and municipal engineering projects, including road and bridge/tunnel maintenance and reinforcement, structural reinforcement, and municipal road management. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Fuzhou, China. Fujian Tendering Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Fujian Tendering Purchasing Group Co., Ltd.
